content: sqflite: raw SQLite access, not type-safe, manual SQL. Drift: type-safe SQLite wrapper with compile-time query checking, built-in transactions/migrations/batched updates, stable and well-tested, used in production apps. Hive: NoSQL key-value store, fast and simple API but less mature/tested than SQLite-based options, reliability concerns noted for production. For crash-safe incremental writes, SQLite-backed options (sqflite/drift) leverage SQLite's durable per-statement commits; Drift recommended for simple apps needing both safety and reduced boilerplate.
